SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. File No. 609 No. D Date 28/4/35/1）
Date May 18, 1936
Subject ALFONSI.
Made by A.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by R.B. Somerset.
With reference to the attached memo of the D.C.
(Special Branch) dated May 7, 1935, on the subject of one Alfonsi, he professes to be able to furnish secret and valuable political information, enquiries show that this individual is, in all probability, identical with L.A. Alfonsi, French of Corsican origin, ex-detective of the French Police, Shanghai.
He resigned from the French Police in 1922 after about fifteen years of service and left for France. It is reported that at that time he had the reputation of being a rich person. However, after two years of residence in France he returned to Shanghai almost penniless and made an unsuccessful attempt to rejoin the French Police. P. After a period during which he made his living by acting as souteneur for two French prostitutes, he obtained employment with Following his return to Shanghai he is reported to have been working for the late French lawyer Du Pac de Marsoulies for some time and also to have been engaged in various enterprises of a doubtful character. In 1930 he left for Indo-China where he was subsequently arrested and sentenced to a term of imprisonment for arms smuggling. Having served his term of imprisonment he returned to Shanghai and has since been residing in this city. He is known to the Municipal Police as suspected arms and narcotics smuggler. In April 1935 he was under the surveillance of the French Police on suspicion of being engaged in gambling activities.
Alfonsi is about 60 years of age. He is reported to be a fluent speaker of Chinese and to have a large circle of acquaintances among Chinese.
At present he resides in a room above a cheap Chinese restaurant at No 334 Rue Bourgeat.
（批：Reg. Please file Copies for "A" and I. already sent. J.P.S.）
20 MAY 1935 D.C. ( Special Branch)
A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别科登记处。档案号 609 编号 D 日期 1935年4月28日/1）
日期 1936年5月18日
事由 阿尔丰西（Alfonsi）。
撰写人 A.I. 普罗科菲耶夫。转呈人 R.B. 萨默塞特。
关于附上的特别科副总监于1935年5月7日就一名叫阿尔丰西的人所写的备忘录，此人声称能够提供秘密且有价值的政治情报，调查显示，此人极有可能是 L.A. 阿尔丰西，法籍，科西嘉裔，前上海法国警察厅侦探。
他在法国警察厅服务约十五年后，于1922年辞职前往法国。据报道，当时他有富人之名。然而，在法国居住两年后，他几乎身无分文地回到上海，并试图重新加入法国警察厅但未获成功。此后有一段时间，他靠为两名法国妓女充当皮条客谋生，随后受雇于……据报，他回到上海后，曾为已故的法国律师杜帕克·德·马苏利埃（Du Pac de Marsoulies）工作了一段时间，并从事各种性质可疑的商业活动。1930年，他前往印度支那，随后因走私武器被捕并被判处监禁。服刑期满后，他返回上海，此后一直居住在该市。工部局警务处知悉其涉嫌走私武器和毒品。1935年4月，法国警察厅因涉嫌其参与赌博活动而对其实施监视。
阿尔丰西约60岁。据报他能说流利的中文，并在华人中拥有广泛的熟人圈。
目前，他居住在布尔热亚路（Rue Bourgeat）334号一家廉价中餐馆楼上的一个房间里。
（批注：登记处。请归档。“A”类和“I”类副本已发送。J.P.S.）
1935年5月20日 特别科副总监
A. 普罗科菲耶夫
高级侦探督察

摘自档案 I.O.7566 - 中国侦探
学校，芝罘路，曹家渡。

康杜伊特（Conduit）侦探总监于1928年12月31日的报告。

上海吴淞警察厅侦探学校
是中国第一所此类学校，由
前防卫专员陈达坚将军于大约6个月前
创立。

前法国警察厅首席侦探阿方索（Alphonso）是
教官之一，教授指纹识别系统和
法语。同时也教授英语。
